records.title: A Distributed Data-Parallel PyTorch Implementation of the Distributed Shampoo Optimizer for Training Neural Networks At-Scale
records.reason: Distributed Shampoo is a data-parallel optimizer for neural-network training, not the linked GPU offload/inference-serving problem.

records.title: Caution for the Environment: Multimodal Agents are Susceptible to Environmental Distractions
records.reason: This evaluates multimodal-agent robustness to visual distractions; it proposes no inference scheduling or efficiency technique.

records.title: Large models for intelligent transportation systems and autonomous vehicles: A survey
records.reason: The transportation/AV survey may discuss efficient LLM deployment but is application-domain synthesis; publisher full text was unavailable for method-level review.

records.title: TCMChat: A Generative Large Language Model for Traditional Chinese Medicine.
records.reason: Title/abstract identifies a domain task or contribution with no plausible LLM inference-system or serving contribution.

records.title: Tag-LLM: Repurposing General-Purpose LLMs for Specialized Domains
records.reason: Tag-based adapters specialize LLMs, but the work focuses on task adaptation/quality rather than inference latency, memory, or serving.
